requirements.fulltext: when request the ResponseSystem shall within 3 ticks satisfy response
requirements.rationale: Experimental interpretation candidate; not an ambiguity annotation or stakeholder probability supplied by NASA.

semantics.description:
SCOPE: in the interval defined by the entire execution.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (request) is true and any point in the interval where (request) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (response) must hold at some point with distance <= 3 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+3). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+3, then (response) need not hold.
semantics.probabilistic_description:
SCOPE: in the interval defined by the entire execution.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (request) is true and any point in the interval where (request) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, with probability >=1, (response) must hold at some point with distance <= 3 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+3). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+3, then (response) need not hold.
semantics.ft: ((LAST V (((! request) & ((! LAST) & (X request))) -> (X ((F[<=3] response) | (F[<3] LAST))))) & (request -> ((F[<=3] response) | (F[<3] LAST))))
semantics.CoCoSpecCode: H((OT(3, 3, ((request and ZtoPre(not (request))) and not (response))) => OT(2, 0, (ZtoPre(false) or response))))
semantics.ftExpanded: ((LAST V (((! request) & ((! LAST) & (X request))) -> (X ((F[0,3] response) | (F[0,2] LAST))))) & (request -> ((F[0,3] response) | (F[0,2] LAST))))
